scope: new matched frozen-backbone head retraining, retrospective development; not historical replay or independent validation

arms.with_morphology: all ten normalized candidate values enter both frozen backbone and head composition
arms.without_morphology: same architecture and feature widths, but all ten inputs zeroed before backbone and head composition

sources.rhythm: Chapman only; Stage A documented record-as-patient proxy, not independently validated patient identifiers
sources.pathology: PTB-XL v1.0.3, official patient folds 1-7 train, frozen Stage A fold-9 calibration/internal evaluation; fold 8 not used, fold 10 forbidden

dedup: reuse hash-sealed Stage A exact waveform exclusions; additionally verify no component or signal crosses active splits from private inventory

training.model: classwise linear logistic head on frozen features, equal architecture in both arms
training.optimizer: deterministic full-batch L-BFGS-B, zero initialization, train-only feature centering/scaling, equal ECG weighting within class
training.nonconvergence: mark endpoint unsupported in both arms
training.calibration: F1-maximizing threshold on calibration records only, ties pick highest threshold
training.rhythm_window_aggregation: P6 sigmoid of mean logits; P8 mean sigmoid; P4 one window

statistics.unit: PTB-XL patient or Chapman record-as-patient proxy
statistics.primary_contrast: paired with minus without endpoint macro-F1
statistics.unsupported: null when there is no common valid support; no favorable endpoint substitution
